title: The espresso machine
logline: Gully's two-group espresso machine, close, twenty years old, chrome gone dull, the steam wand's cloth, a crab sticker on its side. The thing the strip drew behind Gully for two decades, given its own page.

panels.composition: Close on an old two-group espresso machine on a shop counter, chrome dulled, a folded cloth on the steam wand, a small crab sticker on its side, a cup under one group.
